items.title: Go 1.27 Interactive Tour
items.author: Hixon10
items.summary: Go 1.27 introduces an experimental simd package for SIMD operations and a Sleep helper in testing/synctest. It also includes new features like uuid and jsonv2. The release focuses on performance and concurrency improvements.

items.title: AI financial advice is surprisingly good, especially if you ask right questions
items.author: foxtrot8672
items.summary: AI can provide general financial advice but lacks the nuance and personal context of human advisors for complex decisions. It's best used for basic planning and research. Always consult a professional for personalized advice.

items.title: RFC 10015: Deprecating Obsolete Key Exchange Methods in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2
items.author: Jimmc414
items.summary: RFC 10015 deprecates Diffie-Hellman (DH) over finite fields and RSA for key exchanges in TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2. It also discourages static Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) cipher suites. This standard is effective as of August 2026.

items.title: But can your calculator run Linux?
items.author: jandeboevrie
items.summary: Some graphing calculators, like the TI-Nspire, can run Linux. This is possible through custom software. It requires specific hardware and modifications.

items.title: Persistent State Machines: LLM Attention with INT4 In-Memory Cells
items.author: yusuke_esaka
items.summary: INT4 in-memory cells enhance LLM attention efficiency with reduced precision. They use asymmetric quantization for computational gains. This approach balances performance and energy efficiency.

items.title: Explorative modeling: Train on the best of K guesses
items.author: DSemba
items.summary: Explorative Modeling trains models by generating K guesses and training on the best match, committing to specific modes rather than averaging. It adds a third pretraining axis beyond parameters and data. This method improves model predictions by focusing on the best-matching guess.

items.title: AI opens new era in cognitive studies of wild primates
items.author: hhs
items.summary: Scientists developed an AI system called CapuchinAI to automate cognitive studies of capuchin monkeys in the wild using facial recognition and touchscreen testing. The American Journal of Primatology published a proof-of-concept for this novel method. This AI system provides a scalable way to evaluate primate cognitive abilities in the field.

items.title: The Greenhouse and the Lens: Two Modes of Agentic AI Work
items.author: aaronbrethorst
items.summary: Agentic AI operates in Explore and Refine modes, with the former capturing broad options and the latter applying constraints. Multi-agent systems are often used for complex tasks. The choice between single-agent and multi-agent systems depends on workflow complexity.

items.title: Kobuk the Destroyer – Tales from the Wild, Unseen World of Test Engineering
items.author: ripe
items.summary: "Kobuk the Destroyer" by Alex Davies explores the unconventional and inventive methods test engineers use to ensure product safety and reliability. The book highlights the often bizarre and creative approaches engineers take to test products rigorously.

items.title: The Burau representation of the braid group is faithful for n = 4
items.author: wglb
items.summary: The Burau representation of the braid group is known to be faithful for n=4. This result was recently confirmed in a 2026 paper. The significance of this finding is substantial in geometric topology.

items.title: Kaisel – Routes as Values. Dart 3 Native Router for Flutter
items.author: TheWiggles
items.summary: Kaisel is a Dart 3-native router for Flutter that uses sealed classes for routes, eliminating string paths and code generation. It supports exhaustive navigation and has migration guides.

items.title: RFC 9987: Secure Shell (SSH) Agent Protocol
items.author: Jimmc414
items.summary: RFC 9987 specifies a key agent protocol for Secure Shell (SSH) to manage private keys. It is a proposed standard by D. Miller, published in May 2026. The protocol allows SSH clients to interact with a key management agent.

items.title: Show HN: Symbio self fine-tuning AI loop
items.author: huyedit
items.text: It trains based off the mistakes it made with the solution you gave OR what it got. Thank you for reading
items.summary: Symbio self fine-tuning AI loop involves human oversight for model adjustments and continuous improvement. It leverages feedback to refine outputs and adapt to specific use cases. This method enhances precision and relevance over time.

items.title: Show HN: Wage Against the Machine – MacWages Index for AI Tasks
items.author: danr4
items.summary: Wage Against the Machine is a MacWages Index for AI tasks. It measures compensation for automatable jobs. Minimum wage increases can reallocate labor from automatable tasks.

items.title: Mechanical strain creates chirality
items.author: hhs
items.summary: Mechanical strain can induce chirality in non-chiral crystals, allowing control over the resulting handedness. This effect, known as piezochirality, can be tuned by changing the direction or type of strain applied.

items.title: Solid Queue 1.6.0 now supports fiber workers
items.author: earcar
items.summary: Solid Queue 1.6.0 now supports fiber workers, enhancing its ability to handle I/O-bound tasks efficiently. This update improves performance for database-shaped workloads. Fiber workers allow for better resource utilization compared to traditional thread-based execution.

items.title: Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest
items.author: swyx
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has been updated to a stateless version, improving HTTP infrastructure compatibility and reducing session management overhead. This update has rekindled interest in MCP, leading to new tools and enhancements. The stateless nature allows applications to maintain their own state independently.

items.title: Drug reverses autism-like brain changes in adult mice within hours
items.author: gmays
items.summary: Rapamycin rapidly reverses autism-like brain changes in adult mice within hours, improving neuron activity and behavior. The drug rebalances brain cell excitability without structural changes. Its effects are temporary and lose efficacy with repeated dosing.
